title: A torsion-free group algebra that is not directly finite

result.label: A torsion-free group algebra that is not directly finite
result.statement: Constructs a finitely presented torsion-free nonsofic group whose group algebra over 𝔽 2 is not directly finite, disproving Kaplansky's conjecture even without torsion. Companion examples give injective nonsurjective cellular automata on all configurations, refuting Gottschalk's surjunctivity conjecture. Another counterexample is an integral group-ring matrix, invertible over the rational group ring, with Fuglede–Kadison determinant strictly between zero and one, disproving the unrestricted Determinant Conjecture.
